summary: Sibanye Stillwater Limited filed a Form 6-K (operating update for Q1 2026) with the SEC. The report provides operational statistics—production output, adjusted EBITDA (R19.4 billion/$1.2 billion, up 371%), all-in sustaining costs, and segment performance for South African and US PGM operations, gold operations, recycling, and lithium projects. There are no transactional terms, board recommendations, or structural changes. The filing is a routine quarterly update, not a special situation. No action, deal, or event triggers special-situations classification.
